_why: Everything project-specific lives here so the tools and rules stay portable. Edit this, not the tools.
_sourceGlobs: Theme folders only. Without these the Stop hook and shared-rules discover see no .liquid file and stay green for the wrong reason. Patterns use fnmatch, where * also crosses '/', so templates/* covers templates/customers/*.json.
_apps: Top-level dirs that are separate apps. Empty for a single-app repo. Used to label guards and to spot the same rule diverging between apps.
_guards: guardGlobs = where guards live. guardRequiredGlobs = where a missing @guard docblock is an error rather than an opt-out. Guards run on Node's built-in test runner, so the theme needs no package.json.
_commands: How this theme is checked. There is no install step (Dawn has no dependencies; Shopify CLI is global) and no build step (Shopify serves Liquid as-is), so build is empty on purpose — do not report it as passed. typecheck is tools/run js-syntax: node --check over assets/*.js, the only code Theme Check does not parse. dev is how a change is actually seen: it needs a development store and runs until stopped.
_sources: Where correctness comes from, most authoritative first. The review commands cite these by name.

sourcesOfTruth.name: brief
sourcesOfTruth.note: the trainer's exercise brief, pasted verbatim and never edited. Every spec rule quotes it. Where it is silent or ambiguous, that is an OPEN QUESTION for the trainer, not a choice to make quietly.

sourcesOfTruth.name: design
sourcesOfTruth.note: screenshots or a Figma link. Decides layout, states, copy and breakpoints. Does not decide which settings the merchant gets in the theme editor unless the brief says so.

sourcesOfTruth.name: shopify-dev
sourcesOfTruth.note: decides what a Liquid object, filter, tag, schema attribute or Ajax API endpoint actually does. Open the reference page; never rely on memory of the Liquid API.

sourcesOfTruth.name: dawn
sourcesOfTruth.note: convention, not requirement: how Dawn already does the same job (CSS classes, custom elements, asset loading, section rendering). Follow it unless the brief says otherwise.

sourcesOfTruth.name: spec
sourcesOfTruth.note: one spec per exercise, approved before code. The trainer's answers recorded in its decision table post-date the brief, so on exactly those points they win over it.

sourcesOfTruth.name: plan
sourcesOfTruth.note: one plan per change, written before the edit
